fixes.explanation: Elijah, a prophet of Israel, is a big name, and I get why he jumped out at you, friend. But this passage never mentions him. Paul says they "…await His Son from heaven…" (1 Thessalonians 1:10). Nobody in this letter is camped by the window waiting on a prophet. They're waiting on God's Son.

Careful, friend, this one is a trick of the eyes, because the statement is true. Paul says they await His Son from heaven, "…whom He raised from the dead…" (1 Thessalonians 1:10). The One they wait for and the One God raised are the same Son. Pick True next time and the verse has your back.
